title: Ghostenger WebSocket Envelope
description: All WebSocket messages are wrapped in this envelope. The server never sees plaintext payload content.

id.description: Client-generated message UUID for deduplication and acks

message.send.description: Client → Server: send an encrypted message

ciphertext.description: Base64-encoded Double Ratchet ciphertext. Server stores this opaquely.

messageType.description: 0 = normal ratchet message, 1 = prekey message (first in session)

message.new.description: Server → Client: a new encrypted message arrived

message.ack.description: Client → Server: acknowledge delivery of a message

presence.update.description: Server → Client: a contact came online/offline

typing.description: Client → Server or Server → Client: typing indicator
